sheets.noticed: Blue blueprint screen, 'A BOAT CAN'T SAIL UPHILL' at the top, a little boat on a low step and a higher step. The drawing is small in the middle of the TV; the tiny labels I can't read from the couch.
Heading changes to 'so a canal lock lifts it, with nothing but water'. The water is a tan, sandy color, took me a second to get that it's water.
Nothing moves, just the heading and the captions under the drawing. Getting a bit slow.
Yellow '1. The boat goes into the chamber' and the boat slides right. Something happening, okay.
'2. The gates close behind it', a dark line drops in behind the boat.
Holds there a while, then '3. A sluice in the upper gate opens'. Mostly reading the yellow headings.
A tiny thing on the right wall labeled 'sluice'. Too small to really see from here.
'4. Water pours in' and the middle block rises with the boat on top. That's the bit that makes it click.
Boat keeps going up until it's level with the upper side.
Same picture, no talking. Drifting, but it's clearly almost done.
'5. Levels match, so the upper gates open'. I didn't really see a gate open.
Nothing changes for a bit, waiting for the boat to move.
'The boat sails on, higher', boat slides onto the upper canal.
Ends on the boat up top.

remembers: Boats can't go uphill, so a canal lock shuts the boat in a box and fills it with water until it floats up to the higher level, then it sails out.
